files.name: motion-prompt-043.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Whip pan" (ホイップパン), one of the names in "Camera moves & transitions".
Motion Prompt #043

What it is: Fast pan blur into the next shot
What the sample shows: The camera swings sideways very fast and the next scene is swapped in during the streaked blur.
Spec:
- Join: 0.8 s, from 1.7 s to 2.5 s; in the first 0.4 s the outgoing shot swings away, in the last 0.4 s the incoming shot swings in and settles
- First half: outgoing yaw 0 → +0.45 rad (about 26°), quadratic ease-in-out; second half: incoming yaw -0.45 rad → 0, same easing
- Swap: a straight replacement at the 50% point, hidden because the blur is at its strongest
- Blur: 9 renders spread over ±1.6 frames (at 30 fps) are averaged
- Camera: height 1.4 m, fixed except during the swing; the subjects (a person in A, a car and city in B) do not move
- Alternates A→B and B→A every 4.7 s (9.4 s for the round trip); top-right readout shows "A → B" / "B → A"
When to use it: To change location or topic while keeping the energy up.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/043.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/camera.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
